'''Portable Originium Rig''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A mining rig for digging up Originium Ore. This rig does not need to be connected to the power grid to work as it powers itself using the Originium it mines.|The best selling product of Endfield Industries.}}
==Usage==
A mining rig for digging up [[Originium Ore]]. This rig does not need to be connected to the power grid to work as it powers itself using the Originium it mines.
*Despite being powered by itself, this rig does not has Belt-free Transportation and thus can't automatically transfer mined ore to the Depot.

==Acquisition==
*Requirement : [[AIC Plan#Basic AIC Plan|Basic AIC Plan - Basic AIC I - Mining I]]
{{RecipeTable|product=Portable Originium Rig}}
